articles.title: Ukraine drones strike Russia’s e-commerce giant Wildberries, hit 20 warehouses
articles.description: Ukraine's targeted drone strikes are wreaking havoc on Russian e-commerce hubs, particularly affecting Wildberries, one of the largest online retailers. The damage has led to significant inventory losses and logistical challenges for tens of thousands of small enterprises. As a result, sales and delivery operations at Wildberries' pickup locations are severely disrupted. The Russian central bank is closely tracking the potential for inflation amidst these ongoing supply chain complications.

articles.title: Mid-year ecommerce sales set to cool as costs heat up
articles.description: Online sales volumes are expected to grow about 10-15%, compared with 20% last year when Independence Day and Raksha Bandhan coincided, boosting purchases, according to analysts. Ecommerce majors Amazon and Flipkart started their Independence Day sale events last Friday. For the platforms, demand during the period is usually driven by Raksha Bandhan gifting purchases. This year, Raksha Bandhan comes around a fortnight after the sale events end.

articles.description: India, LinkedIn's second-largest and fastest-growing market with more than 186 million members, is also seeing a sharp rise in its share of US companies’ overseas R&D hiring as well as in the number of entrepreneurs. CEO Dan Shapero too had initially set out to be an entrepreneur, starting his first company at 19. But joining LinkedIn in 2008 reshaped his career trajectory.

articles.title: Zomato’s District is shopping for growth beyond its dining business
articles.description: CEO Rahul Ganjoo told ET that while dining will remain District’s biggest category en route to a targeted $3 billion net order value (NOV), the retail vertical is growing rapidly and could overtake movies. “Retail is growing really fast... our shopping vertical has real potential, to become one of the bigger ones (categories). I wouldn’t say as big as dining, but I’d almost bet it would become our second-biggest vertical within three years, based on the growth we’re seeing,” Ganjoo said.

articles.title: Can Molbio Diagnostics IPO deliver long-term growth for high risk investors?
articles.description: Molbio Diagnostics aims to secure ₹200 crore to enhance its capital expenditures through a new issuance of shares. In tandem, the firm intends to reduce promoter stake by generating ₹740 crore via an offer for sale. With six manufacturing sites worldwide, the company caters to over ninety nations and has seen substantial revenue growth attributed to its tuberculosis diagnostic test kits.

articles.title: US Stock Market: Berkshire steps up buybacks, boosts Alphabet stake as cash falls
articles.description: Berkshire Hathaway began deploying its cash pile in Q2, buying nearly $20 billion more stocks than it sold and ending a 14-quarter selling streak. It also repurchased $4.5 billion of its own shares in Q2 and bought about $10 billion of Alphabet stock, while posting better-than-expected operating profit.

articles.title: IFC invests Rs 225 cr in NDR Smart Spaces to develop 20 million sq ft logistics platform
articles.description: The International Finance Corporation has invested Rs 225 crore in NDR Smart Spaces. This investment will support the development of 20 million sq ft of warehousing infrastructure. The project focuses on tier 2 and tier 3 cities across India. NDR Smart Spaces will also develop cold storage facilities to address supply chain gaps. This initiative is expected to create approximately 24,000 direct jobs.
